messages:
Linda M.: Quick checklist for next Wed customer roundtable (Nov 15) — registration page + Zoom + recording + lead routing. Need owners and any blockers by EOD.
Tom O.: Got it. I'll own Zoom config and RTMP fallback. Which recorder do we want? Need RTMP creds.
Linda M.: Assigning Eli to recording + handoff. @Eli P. you're on recording & SRT export. Pair with @Tom O. on RTMP fallback.
Eli P.: On it. Plan: cloud recording + local backup. Enable cloud record (mp4) + audio transcript (SRT). I'll upload final mp4 + srt to GDrive: /shared/events/2071.
Aria (Design): I'll finish the reg page hero and prepare two CTAs for A/B test: 'Save my seat' vs 'Get the recording'. Will add speaker photos + local time selector.
Sara G.: Lead routing: HubSpot list + UTM capture. Use Zapier to tag 'attended' vs 'registered' and enrich with Clearbit. Required reg fields: email, company, role, consent checkbox. GDPR ok?
Tom O.: Consent checkbox required. For RTMP fallback use stream.redwood-inference.com:443/<stream-key>. @Eli I'll DM the key. Also: keep join-before-host OFF (host only).
Eli P.: DM sent with stream key. Zoom admin settings to enable: 'Record to cloud', 'Audio transcript', set @Tom O. as alternative host. Record layout: active speaker + gallery, separate audio track.
Linda M.: Post-event flow idea: 1) run transcript through whisper for TAT, redact PII, 2) create 90s highlight + full replay, 3) push clips to socials + send replay email. Who can own clip editing?
Sara G.: I'll own clip editing pipeline with Cliply (vendor). They take SRTs -> produce 3 clips (90s, 45s, 15s). HubSpot: send 'thanks' + replay link 1hr after event, then a 3-day nurture with benchmark assets.
Aria (Design): Draft CTAs: 1) 'Save my seat — live demo & cost benchmark' 2) 'Get the recording — can't make it? we'll send the replay'. Also note accessibility: enable captions on the replay player and include alt text for images.
Tom O.: Quick admin checklist to paste into Zoom settings page: 
```
Zoom settings (admin):
- Record to cloud: ON
- Audio transcript: ON
- Alternative host: tom.ops@redwood.com
- Auto-upload to GDrive: ON (folder: /shared/events/2071)
- Breakout rooms: OFF
- Join before host: OFF
```
Eli P.: Local backup command for ops (I'll run this on the capture box):
```bash
ffmpeg -i rtmp://stream.redwood-inference.com/<key> -c copy /mnt/rec/event-2071-$(date +%s).mp4
```
Linda M.: Legal asked for the consent copy. Proposed text: 'By registering you agree to receive marketing emails from Redwood Inference and partner sponsors. You can unsubscribe at any time.' OK?
Sara G.: That's fine. I'll add a GDPR/EEA checkbox that must be checked to register and log consent timestamp to HubSpot. Zap mapping snippet (for ops):
```
- email -> contact.email
- company -> contact.company
- role -> contact.title
- utm_source/medium/campaign -> contact.properties
- consent -> contact.properties.gdpr_opt_in
- attended -> contact.properties.event_attended (true/false)
```
Tom O.: Dry-run: I propose Tue 10am PT. I'll schedule a test meeting with cloud record + RTMP to confirm both uploads. Everyone available for 30 min?
Eli P.: Available. I'll reserve the capture VM and test storage paths.
Aria (Design): Available, I'll bring the final reg page HTML for a quick QA.
Sara G.: Available, I'll test Zapier mappings during the run.
Linda M.: Awesome, team. Blockers?
Tom O.: None from infra side. I'll also enable a 24h reminder via Event Bot.
Event Bot: Reminder scheduled — 24 hours before event start.
Linda M.: Thanks all — please DM if anything changes. I'll collate final checklist tomorrow morning and ping again. :thumbsup:
